verdict.rationale: Navan documents its own retrieval API for expense data: 12 retrieval endpoints with pagination and field selection covering card transactions, manual expenses, users, and per-transaction activity history. That gives a programmatic way to pull a meaningful share of a company's data out. The hosted MCP server also allows natural-language querying of spend and travel data, but it is built for analysis rather than export. Missing for 10: any documented bulk or full-account export feature, any named open export formats (e.g., CSV/JSON dumps), API coverage of travel and booking data rather than just the expense surface, and any offboarding or data-portability documentation or independent corroboration.
